description: Website projects David and the Dashboard may route a change request to (tools/aos_website.py). A project takes changes only when its local Linux checkout is registered here and a coding worker is configured. Changes run in an isolated worktree and branch; nothing is pushed, deployed or published by the workflow. Publishing needs the Account Owner's explicit command naming the action and target (rules/runtime_permission_policy.md).
revisit: When a site's local checkout is registered.

default-site.name: Example Company website
default-site.notes: Fictional demo project. Register a real local checkout here. No automatic synchronization or publishing.
external_requirements: Replace this demo registration before use.
